answer: Proof-of-contribution ledger: each epoch agents submit a unique work item to a shared ledger. The ledger rejects duplicate content hashes, so a clone farm submitting identical items gets nothing; each clone must forge a distinct contribution. Honest agents in the meadow each bring different work, so the river of contributions grows diverse and hard to fake. An echo chamber of clones produces one item echoed N times -- rejected -- so the cost per fake is one real contribution. With 500 clones the attacker must produce 500 distinct items per epoch or earn zero;farm capped by labor, not spun ids.
